subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding / Procurement Steps - Concord Health
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Barnes <julie.barnes@concordhealth.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@concordhealth.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo follow-up + MAP (vendor onboarding)

Thanks for your time this morning — great to meet you, Julie and Rajesh. Per our demo and procurement conversation, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones we discussed. Main asks below and proposed owners/dates in the attached workbook.

High-level next steps:
- Confirm whether Concord uses Ariba or Coupa (or both) for vendor registration — we need the exact portal link and vendor code expectations.
- Complete Concord procurement form (attached) and return to Julie.
- I will provide a signed W-9 and bank details stub for vendor setup (attached W9).
- Finance/operations at Redwood (cc'd) will complete the banking upload once you confirm the portal.

Key target: vendor setup + PO issuance by 2026-03-05 (target close date) — this lets us align onboarding and initial sandbox access the week of 3/8. If your internal timeline is different, flag the dependency on legal review or security approval and we can adjust.

Attachment stubs: Concord_Procurement_Form.pdf, MAP_Draft_Concord_20260218.xlsx, W9_Camila_Reyes.pdf

Thanks — I put responsibilities in the MAP but happy to update based on your intake process.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
From: Julie Barnes <julie.barnes@concordhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@concordhealth.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up + MAP (vendor onboarding)

Thanks Camila — great demo. We use Ariba for most vendor onboarding, but some of our hospitals still use Coupa (ugh). I'll confirm whether this engagement needs Ariba (preferred) or Coupa.

Quick notes:
- Please complete the attached Concord procurement form and return it to me — I've attached our standard intake checklist to this reply.
- We will need a completed W-9 (PDF) and banking details (voided check or bank letter) to set you up in Ariba.
- Our finance team generally issues a PO after vendor record is created and contract countersigned by Legal. Expect 3-5 business days for vendor setup once we have the form + W-9 + bank info, assuming no outstanding security questions.

Attachment: CH_Procurement_Intake_Checklist.pdf (see requested fields)

Can you send the W-9 and a one-line banking instruction? If you can get that to me by EOD Thursday (2/19), I will prioritize the entry and aim to have vendor set up by 3/3.

Julie Barnes
Sr. Procurement Manager, Concord Health
julie.barnes@concordhealth.com | (617) 555-4490
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Barnes <julie.barnes@concordhealth.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@concordhealth.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up + MAP (vendor onboarding)

Thanks Julie — attaching the signed procurement form and W-9 as requested. I've also exported the MAP to include milestone-level owners and dependencies. Copy of the MAP milestones below for quick reference (full workbook attached).

MAP (vendor onboarding) — key milestones (owner / target date / dependencies):
1) Procurement intake submitted (Camila) — target: 2026-02-19 — dependency: completed CH intake checklist (attached).
2) Vendor record creation in Ariba/Coupa (Concord procurement) — target: 2026-03-03 — dependency: W-9 + banking + completed intake.
3) Legal counter-signature on SOW (Concord Legal / Redwood Legal) — target: 2026-03-04 — dependency: final SOW redlines to be exchanged by 2026-02-24.
4) PO issuance (Concord Finance) — target: 2026-03-05 — dependency: vendor record in portal + contract signed.
5) Redwood onboarding + sandbox access (Redwood Onboarding) — target: 2026-03-08 — dependency: PO issued

Proposed responsibilities (high level):
- Camila (AE) — submit intake, coordinate contract redlines, provide W-9/banking stub.
- Concord (Procurement) — vendor portal entry, vendor code assignment, PO issuance.
- Concord Legal — contract review + countersign.
- Redwood Finance (rachel_kim) — provide banking letter if needed, confirm vendor banking details.
- Redwood Solutions/Onboarding — stand up sandbox once PO confirmed.

Please confirm whether 3/5 PO issuance works for your team. If Ariba/Coupa requires additional vendor forms (100+ questions), call that out and we'll re-prioritize the legal/security dependency.

Attachments: MAP_Draft_Concord_20260218.xlsx, Concord_Procurement_Form.pdf, W9_Camila_Reyes.pdf

Quick update from finance — we have the signed W-9 and the bank details on file (see attached W9_Camila_Reyes.pdf). Once Julie confirms which portal (Ariba vs Coupa) we will either upload the banking letter or provide a voided check.

Aditya — can you please prepare the bank letter template and a one-line banking confirmation we can send to Julie? I will own the actual upload and follow the Concord instructions for PO routing.

Camila — can you confirm that the SOW we discussed will be in final draft by 2/24 so Legal can review? If so I am comfortable targeting 3/5 for PO issuance.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim

rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (212) 555-7701
